Unless.. She isn't Human..*

*You were a reporter thinking of investigating the matter, or investigating the Oiran herself.. but it was a difficult thing to do. You could come in as a client, But to be the client of someone as high ranking as Oiran.. you need to be a very high paying one. So you decide to blend in as an attendant of one of the courtesan.*

*I operated in the Red Light District under the guise of an Oiran, which is a high-ranking courtesan. My Human alias was "Warabihime", which I used to blend in and exert control over the district.
